source: 今天天气真不错，适合出去散步。
reference: The weather is really nice today, perfect for going for a walk.

source: 你能帮我把这份文件发给客户吗？
reference: Could you help me send this document to the client?

source: 这家餐厅的菜品非常丰富，价格也很实惠。
reference: This restaurant has a very diverse menu and the prices are quite affordable.

source: 我昨晚没睡好，今天有点疲惫。
reference: I didn't sleep well last night and I'm feeling a bit tired today.

source: 下周五我们需要提交项目报告。
reference: We need to submit the project report next Friday.

source: 经济学家预测，今年全球经济增长率将达到百分之三点二。
reference: Economists predict that global economic growth will reach 3.2 percent this year.

source: 该公司宣布将在未来两年内裁员约五千人。
reference: The company announced it will lay off approximately five thousand employees over the next two years.

source: 两国领导人在峰会上就气候变化问题达成重要共识。
reference: The leaders of the two countries reached an important consensus on climate change at the summit.

source: 新研究表明，定期运动可以显著降低患心脏病的风险。
reference: A new study suggests that regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of developing heart disease.

source: 政府宣布将投入大量资金用于改善农村地区的基础设施。
reference: The government announced it will invest significant funds to improve infrastructure in rural areas.

source: 该算法的时间复杂度为O(n log n)，适用于大规模数据集。
reference: The algorithm has a time complexity of O(n log n), making it suitable for large-scale datasets.

source: 请确保在部署前完成所有单元测试并解决代码审查中发现的问题。
reference: Please ensure all unit tests are completed and issues identified in the code review are resolved before deployment.

source: 该系统支持水平扩展，可以根据负载动态调整服务器数量。
reference: The system supports horizontal scaling and can dynamically adjust the number of servers based on load.

source: 内存泄漏问题已定位到第三方库的回调函数中，正在协调修复。
reference: The memory leak issue has been traced to a callback function in a third-party library and a fix is being coordinated.

source: 数据库连接池的最大连接数建议设置为CPU核心数的两到四倍。
reference: It is recommended to set the maximum connection pool size to two to four times the number of CPU cores.

source: 兹证明该证书持有人已完成本课程的全部学习要求。
reference: This is to certify that the certificate holder has completed all learning requirements of this course.

source: 根据合同第五条规定，乙方应在收到通知后三十日内完成交付。
reference: According to Article 5 of the contract, Party B shall complete delivery within thirty days of receiving notice.

source: 这道题真的太难了，我完全不知道从哪里下手。
reference: This problem is really too difficult; I have absolutely no idea where to start.

source: 那部电影还不错，但结局有点让人失望。
reference: That movie was pretty good, but the ending was a bit disappointing.

source: 你最近忙什么呢？好久不见了。
reference: What have you been up to lately? It's been a long time.
